source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with monumental ink-wash mountains, misty ravines, clustered pavilions, dense trees, scholars, a river boat, and foreground rocks; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central rocky mountain rising through the upper middle, including the dark tree-covered summit, vertical crags, pale washed rock faces, scattered shrubs, and the mist-softened lower edges, but excluding the calligraphy above and lower village roofs.
must_preserve: dense dark ink foliage dots along the summit ridge
vertical cun texture strokes on rock faces
pale tan wash transitions on exposed cliffs
irregular ravine creases and black contour lines
soft mist fading at the mountain base

motifs.name: right_gorge_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall right-side gorge wall with its overhanging wooded ledge, steep pale cliff face, dark crevice, shrubs, and descending narrow ravine beside the waterway, excluding the small village roofs and boat below.
must_preserve: long vertical ink cracks down the pale rock
layered wash shadows in the ravine

motifs.name: midleft_hamlet_roofs
motifs.description: Isolate the small cluster of tiled buildings nestled in the central-left valley, with layered roofs, walls, surrounding low trees, and the enclosing mist and rocky slopes immediately around the houses.
must_preserve: hazy valley wash around the hamlet

motifs.name: lower_left_pavilion_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground pavilion on the lower left with scholars seated inside, the thatched or tiled roof, railings, adjacent boulders, and the small cascading stream below it.
must_preserve: angular pavilion roof ribs and eaves
tiny seated scholar figures around a table
white stepped waterfall strokes beneath the pavilion

motifs.name: central_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense stand of tall pines and slender trees in the lower center, including trunks, dark needle clusters, bamboo-like foliage, and roots growing over the rocky foreground mound.
must_preserve: slender vertical trunks with ink outlines
dark foliage dots at the base

motifs.name: right_riverside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small stacked riverside buildings in the right-middle ravine, including the tiered roofs, posts, terraces, and the narrow misty water or path beside them, but not the separate boat farther below.
must_preserve: mist separating the buildings from the cliffs

motifs.name: scholar_boat_on_river
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat on the lower-right river with the seated figure, low hull, oar or pole details, surrounding calm water, and nearby shoreline reeds and rocks only where they frame the boat.
must_preserve: reeds and low bank rocks around the inlet

motifs.name: foreground_scholars_path
motifs.description: Isolate the group of three scholars or attendants walking on the lower-right foreground path beside rocks, grasses, and shrubs, excluding the boat and distant buildings.
must_preserve: three small robed figures with distinct poses
surrounding grasses, stones, and dark shrub dots

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
